dataset_metadata.official_name: Retinal Fundus Multi-Disease Image Dataset (RFMiD v1.0)
dataset_metadata.publication_citation: Pachade et al. (2021), 'Retinal Fundus Multi-Disease Image Dataset (RFMiD) for Screening of Ophthalmic Diseases', Data, 6(2), 14. doi:10.3390/data6020014
dataset_metadata.challenge_affiliation: Retinal Image Analysis for detecting Diseases (RIADD) Challenge, IEEE ISBI 2021
dataset_metadata.modalities: Topcon 3D OCT-2000 (4288x2848), Carl Zeiss VISUCAM 500 (2048x1536), and Kowa VX-10alpha (2144x1424)

total_cohort.evaluation_scope: Full N=3,200 labelled cohort available for external evaluation

protocol_compliance_verification.internal_model_inference_status: ZERO_INFERENCES (Model weights strictly un-evaluated on external cohort during preflight)
protocol_compliance_verification.internal_test_set_quarantine: PRESERVED (data_clean/test remains completely isolated; zero inferences)
protocol_compliance_verification.threshold_tuning_status: ZERO_TUNING (Thresholds frozen from internal validation; threshold-independent AUROC/PR-AUC prioritized)
protocol_compliance_verification.evaluation_paradigm: One-vs-Rest Binary Classification per condition; mutually exclusive softmax prohibited due to multi-label ground truth
protocol_compliance_verification.retinal_detachment_status: UNAVAILABLE for direct external validation; RFMiD RT represents Retinal Traction Detachment (N=25) which is etiologically non-equivalent to primary RD. RT restricted to secondary exploratory analysis.
protocol_compliance_verification.glaucoma_status: APPROXIMATE: RFMiD ODC represents Optic Disc Cupping (N=445) as a morphological sign, not a definitive clinical glaucoma diagnosis.
protocol_compliance_verification.macular_scar_status: EXACT: RFMiD MS represents Macular Scars (N=27); wide bootstrap CIs pre-registered.
protocol_compliance_verification.retinitis_pigmentosa_status: EXACT but UNDERPOWERED: RFMiD RP has N=10 cases total; restricted to exploratory descriptive reporting.
